decision.reason: Transfer the Earth-validated emulator without regional refitting. Treat the five Shukkai profiles as creative hypotheses to audit, never as fitting targets or model acceptance gates.

provenance.earth_transfer: Earth v0.11 XGBoost continuous emulator and the identical 128 region-independent features; no Shukkai fit.
provenance.planet_constraints: A single global offset preserves the independent 8 C mean; a single global scale preserves 690 mm mean land precipitation.
provenance.interpretation: Shukkai expectations are lore hypotheses. A discrepancy is a terrain-versus-lore finding, not grounds to refit the climate model.
provenance.rutia: Source Illustrator text anchors for Rutia, Rutia Basin, and Rutia Province map to approximately 73 W, 2.5 N; the ellipse is an explicit provisional audit polygon.
provenance.bathymetry: Original v0.3 SST input remains absent; all three deterministic Deladua sensitivity scenarios are retained.
